2.text: Ntimukirengagize gucumbikira abashyitsi, kuko bamwe bacumbikiye abashyitsi, bacumbikiye abamarayika batabizi.

3.text: Mwibuke imbohe nk'ababohanywe na zo, mwibuke n'abagirirwa nabi kuko namwe muri mu mubiri.

4.text: Kurongorana kubahwe na bose, kandi kuryamana kw'abarongoranye kwe kugira ikikwanduza, kuko abahehesi n'abasambanyi Imana izabacira ho iteka.

5.text: Ntimukagire ingeso zo gukunda impiya ahubwo mujye munyurwa n'ibyo mufite, kuko ubwayo yavuze iti “Sinzagusiga na hato, kandi ntabwo nzaguhāna na hato.”

6.text: Ni cyo gituma tuvuga dushize ubwoba tuti“Uwiteka ni umutabazi wanjye, sinzatinya.Umuntu yabasha kuntwara iki?”

7.text: Mwibuke ababayoboraga kera, bakababwira ijambo ry'Imana. Muzirikane iherezo ry'ingeso zabo, mwigane kwizera kwabo.

8.text: Yesu Kristo uko yari ari ejo, n'uyu munsi ni ko ari kandi ni ko azahora iteka ryose.

9.text: Ntimukayobywe n'inyigisho z'uburyo bwinshi bw'inzaduka, kuko ibyiza ari uko umutima wakomezwa n'ubuntu bw'Imana, udakomezwa n'ibyokurya kuko abītaye kuri ibyo bitabagiriye umumaro.

10.text: Dufite igicaniro, icyo abakora umurimo wa rya hema badahawe uburenganzira bwo kuriraho.

11.text: Kuko intumbi z'amatungo, izo umutambyi mukuru ajyana amaraso yazo Ahera kuba impongano y'ibyaha, zitwikirwa inyuma y'urugo.

12.text: Ni cyo cyatumye na Yesu ababarizwa inyuma y'irembo, kugira ngo yejeshe abantu amaraso ye.

13.text: Nuko dusohoke, tumusange inyuma y'urugo twemeye gutukwa ku bwe,

14.text: kuko hano tudafite umudugudu uhoraho, ahubwo dushaka uzaza.

15.text: Nuko tujye dutambira Imana iteka igitambo cy'ishimwe tubiheshejwe na Yesu, ari cyo mbuto z'iminwa ihimbaza izina ryayo.

16.text: Kugira neza no kugira ubuntu ntimukabyibagirwe, kuko ibitambo bisa bityo ari byo binezeza Imana.

17.text: Mwumvire ababayobora mubagandukire, kuko ari bo baba maso barinda imitima yanyu nk'abazabibazwa. Nuko rero, mubumvire kugira ngo babikore banezerewe kandi batagononwa, kuko kubikorana akangononwa kutagira icyo kumarira mwebwe.

18.text: Mudusabire kuko twiringiye yuko tudafite umutima wicira urubanza, tukaba dushaka kugira ingeso nziza muri byose.

19.text: Kandi ndiyongeza kubahugura kudusabira, kugira ngo ntebutswe vuba kubagarurirwa.

20.text: Nuko Imana nyir'amahoro, yazuye Umutahiza w'intama ari we Mwami wacu Yesu, imuzurishije amaraso y'isezerano ry'iteka ryose,

21.text: ibatunganye rwose mu byiza byose kugira ngo mukore ibyo ishaka, ikorera muri mwe ibishimwa imbere yayo ku bwa Yesu Kristo, icyubahiro kibe icye iteka ryose. Amen.

22.text: Bene Data, ndabinginga kugira ngo mwihanganire uku guhugura kwanjye, kuko dore nkubandikiye mu magambo make.

23.text: Ndababwira yuko mwene Data Timoteyo yabohowe, naza vuba nzababona turi kumwe.

24.text: Muntahirize ababayobora bose, muntahirize n'abera bose. Abo muri Italiya barabatashya.

25.text: Ubuntu bw'Imana bubane namwe mwese. Amen.
